title: Catalog and pager sample
description: Builds a list with page navigation from a catalog (JSON) and a JavaScript page.
content_md: This page loads the catalog data ([sample_list]({{PAGE_URL:sample_list}})) with a JavaScript page ([sample_pager]({{PAGE_URL:sample_pager}})) and shows two entries at a time. Both are ordinary pages. With the output format set to JSON or JavaScript, the body is published as it is at `/ID.json` or `/ID.js`.
memo: This page exists to introduce mikanBox's features. When you publish your site, set it to "Draft" or delete it.
